# PaperTrail collaboration workspace
The following runtime stack is adopted for this product.
- RenderKit: display document previews inside the application.
- LookupKit: search saved notes for signed-in users.
- MailRelay: send reminder emails to workspace members.
- ArchiveJob: archive outdated notes automatically within the running product.
- HelperLibrary is also installed; its purpose is unspecified.

Development-only tools:
- TypeChecker: check source-code types during development.
- ImageBuilder: build deployment images in CI.

Deployment guide:
Operators can self-host the service on their own machine.

Undecided proposal:
We may add voice notes in a later release; this is not an adopted requirement.

Rejected scope:
We will not export notes publicly.

Other product:
SketchPeer, a different application, can recognize handwriting.
A retired PaperDemo experiment to search saved notes was rejected; PaperDemo is not this product.
